text: Movement of motor vehicles is prohibited on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section.
Traffic is prohibited on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section, according to information released by the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia.
As stated in the information provided by the Roads Department, the level of avalanche hazard on the mentioned section is high.

According to the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia, based on information from the National Environmental Agency, the avalanche hazard level is high on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section of the Mtskheta-Stepantsminda-Larsi international highway. Due to this, the movement of all types of motor vehicles is temporarily prohibited on the mentioned section.
"According to the National Environmental Agency, traffic on the Mleta-Gudauri section will be carried out in a non-stop mode," the information states.
